title: AI agents for small business: what they are and how to start
seoTitle: AI agents for small business, explained
description: AI agents for small business in plain words: what an agent is, what it can and can't do today, good first jobs, safe permissions and how to start free.
lede: An AI agent is an AI that works toward a goal in steps, using tools and deciding what to do next. This guide explains what AI agents for small business can and can't do today, which jobs to hand over first and how to set safe limits.
